generation.source_clock: synthetic seconds from t=0; ns clocks saved without physical transport delay
generation.motion: prescribed smooth multi-frequency RPY motion; kinematic orientation experiment, not a full six-DoF flight/aircraft simulation
generation.rotation: Rz(yaw) Ry(pitch) Rx(roll), body-to-world, Hamilton quaternion xyzw
generation.kinematics: analytic first/second derivatives of the prescribed RPY curve; exact body omega and alpha via RzRyRx rate mapping
generation.inertia_scope: known fixed physical tensor shared by generator and both comparison methods; no parameter fit
generation.control: body-CoG torque tau=J alpha+omega cross(J omega), generated once from prescribed motion; saved on 1kHz grid and supplied as known input to both methods
generation.torque_interpolation: reconstruction uses saved known torque with piecewise-linear interpolation; finite input interpolation error
generation.gyro_observation: body omega + fixed bias + independent isotropic Gaussian sensor noise
generation.initial_pose: known prescribed pose once at t=0, shared by all cases
generation.gyro_source_index: original 200Hz sequence index, never renumbered after sparse selection

nonlinear.source: original saved six-point angular-rate trajectories and unchanged weights
nonlinear.operation: weighted mean and centered full covariance, with both sides of every acquisition retained
nonlinear.angular_rate_update: fresh independent Gaussian centered at the acquired gyro with covariance sigma^2 I; not Bayesian conditioning of prior rate
nonlinear.linear_forced_covariance: constant sigma^2 I between acquisitions because its angular-rate sensitivity is identity
nonlinear.nonlinear_covariance: nonlinear dynamics can increase or decrease different marginal widths; a new observation need not narrow every axis

linear_forced.source: original saved six-point angular-rate trajectories and unchanged weights
linear_forced.operation: weighted mean and centered full covariance, with both sides of every acquisition retained
linear_forced.angular_rate_update: fresh independent Gaussian centered at the acquired gyro with covariance sigma^2 I; not Bayesian conditioning of prior rate
linear_forced.linear_forced_covariance: constant sigma^2 I between acquisitions because its angular-rate sensitivity is identity
linear_forced.nonlinear_covariance: nonlinear dynamics can increase or decrease different marginal widths; a new observation need not narrow every axis

known_input: same fixed J and 1kHz generated inverse-Euler torque for both methods
gyro_update: fresh independent Gaussian at original acquisition; both before/after limits retained
bands: same law: Euler moment proxy and delta-method RPY covariance; direct angular-rate mean/full covariance; +/-2sigma without clipping
